verzen.tekst: O Lord, Father and Master of my life,
verzen.html: O Lord, Father and Master of my life,

verzen.tekst: Who will set scourges over my thought,
verzen.html: Who will set scourges over my thought,

verzen.tekst: Otherwise my errors might be multiplied,
verzen.html: Otherwise my errors might be multiplied,

verzen.tekst: O Lord, Father and God of my life,
verzen.html: O Lord, Father and God of my life,

verzen.tekst: and turn away evil desire from me.
verzen.html: and turn away evil desire from me.

verzen.tekst: Let neither gluttony nor lust overtake me.
verzen.html: Let neither gluttony nor lust overtake me.

verzen.tekst: Listen, my children, to the discipline of the mouth.
verzen.html: Listen, my children, to the discipline of the mouth.

verzen.tekst: The sinner will be overpowered through his lips.
verzen.html: The sinner will be overpowered through his lips.

verzen.tekst: Don’t accustom your mouth to an oath,
verzen.html: Don’t accustom your mouth to an oath,

verzen.tekst: for as a servant who is continually scourged will not lack bruises,
verzen.html: for as a servant who is continually scourged will not lack bruises,

verzen.tekst: A man of many oaths will be filled with iniquity.
verzen.html: A man of many oaths will be filled with iniquity.

verzen.tekst: There is a manner of speech that is clothed with death.
verzen.html: There is a manner of speech that is clothed with death.

verzen.tekst: Don’t accustom your mouth to gross rudeness,
verzen.html: Don’t accustom your mouth to gross rudeness,

verzen.tekst: Remember your father and your mother,
verzen.html: Remember your father and your mother,

verzen.tekst: A man who is accustomed to abusive language
verzen.html: A man who is accustomed to abusive language

verzen.tekst: Two sorts of people multiply sins,
verzen.html: Two sorts of people multiply sins,

verzen.tekst: All bread is sweet to a fornicator.
verzen.html: All bread is sweet to a fornicator.

verzen.tekst: A man who goes astray from his own marriage bed
verzen.html: A man who goes astray from his own marriage bed

verzen.tekst: The eyes of men are his terror.
verzen.html: The eyes of men are his terror.

verzen.tekst: All things were known to him before they were created,
verzen.html: All things were known to him before they were created,

verzen.tekst: This man will be punished in the streets of the city.
verzen.html: This man will be punished in the streets of the city.

verzen.tekst: So also is a wife who leaves her husband,
verzen.html: So also is a wife who leaves her husband,

verzen.tekst: For first, she was disobedient in the law of the Most High.
verzen.html: For first, she was disobedient in the law of the Most High.

verzen.tekst: She shall be brought out into the congregation.
verzen.html: She shall be brought out into the congregation.

verzen.tekst: Her children will not take root.
verzen.html: Her children will not take root.

verzen.tekst: She will leave her memory for a curse.
verzen.html: She will leave her memory for a curse.

verzen.tekst: And those who are left behind will know that there is nothing better than the fear of the Lord,
